messages.subject: color= CI?
parts:
This is an interesting way to add CIs to a plot

The idea is that broad CI-shading (like ggplot currently gives) attracts the eye to the _least_ reliable ends of the data.

The alternative is to instead set transparency = CI width.

That draws the eye to the section with solid data, and hints with a washed-out shade at the regions we're less sure of.

It's described here:

http://andrewgelman.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/08/HSIANG_VISUALLY_WEIGHTED_REGRESSION_v1.pdf


I still find Figure 1 the most informative of all: just a line and the data points :-)

t
